body: Commits 95c4f2b/174b06a on main. Symmetric revert of S170-178's 7v7 change: ARENA_TEAM_SIZE 7->10, ARENA_SNAPSHOT_MAX_HEROES 14->20, pool-launch scripts and systemd deploy sources reverted to match (not the live host itself -- separate action). Build clean, full suite green. Requested mid a live-pool queueing investigation (matchmaker/server lobby-size mismatch, likely from a concurrent session's own 7v7 deploy) -- this source-level revert doesn't by itself confirm the live host is fixed; that needs a rebuild+restart of the actual running binaries, outside this repo's git history.
title: Move team size back to 10v10 (S170-183)
